title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt New NYSE Arca Rule 8.800-E To Provide for the Listing and Trading of Commodity- and Digital Asset-Based Investment Interests and To List and Trade Shares of the Grayscale Digital Large Cap Fund LLC
summary: On 4 November 2024, the Federal Register published an SEC notice (Release No. 34-101470, File No. SR-NYSEARCA-2024-87) that NYSE Arca had filed a proposed rule change, on 15 October 2024, to adopt new NYSE Arca Rule 8.800-E and to list and trade shares of the Grayscale Digital Large Cap Fund LLC. Unlike existing Rule 8.201-E, limited to trusts holding a single commodity, proposed Rule 8.800-E would cover securities issued by a trust, limited liability company, or other similar entity holding specified commodities, digital assets, Derivative Securities Products, and/or cash. The fund, managed by Grayscale Investments, LLC, would track the CoinDesk Large Cap Select Index; as of the filing date, its Fund Component weightings were Bitcoin 75.46%, Ether 17.90%, Solana 4.13%, XRP 1.86%, and Avalanche 0.65%. Publication opened a public comment period under Exchange Act Section 19(b)(1); the notice itself takes no position on approval or disapproval.
why_it_matters: This is the procedural first step the SEC required before it could approve, disapprove, or open formal proceedings on this proposal: publishing NYSE Arca's filing and inviting public comment on both a new listing category and a specific multi-asset digital fund. Naming the Grayscale Digital Large Cap Fund LLC and its stated digital-asset weightings here reflects only what NYSE Arca's own filing states about that particular fund.
